creative_brief.title: An Encore in the Afternoon
creative_brief.treatment: A fictional pianist gives an informal encore in a small sunlit salon. Warm ivory, dusty rose and charcoal gouache layers keep the piano central; quiet guests at the lower corners frame a shared listening space. Room, recital and closer pianist framings alternate at the six original DSP scenes, with short dissolves and restrained camera movement. Upper-body and wrist motion suggests playing; piano legs, bench and floor remain anchored. Sparse native-audio accents add local warmth at the keys. No storm, moon, cuts on every note, applause or sound effects.
creative_brief.excerpt_selection: DSP cand-01 retained exactly. Its two low-energy endpoints have stronger acoustic support than cand-03, and it avoids the initial quiet stretch in cand-02. Independent checks of interruption risk are recorded in editorial evidence; they do not certify an error-free take.
creative_brief.listening_limit: Auditory listening is unavailable in this environment. Wrong notes and phrase-naturalness cannot be certified from acoustic ranking. The performance is neither repaired nor regenerated.
creative_brief.recent_work_comparison: Available releases studio-pr-6 and studio-issue-20 use moonlit solitude and an outdoor storm recital. This work uses a bright interior, nearby listeners and one continuous layered composition. Release descriptions and storm contact sheet are compared; full prior videos have not been watched.
